ace.ability: Throw hydraulic breaching charges to open reinforced walls and create entry routes.
ace.biography: A Norwegian paramedic who chose field work over medical school, Haugland developed his rescue skills through military service.

alibi.ability: Deploy lookalike holograms that reveal opponents who interact with them.
alibi.biography: De Luca moved from Libya to Italy as a child. Her family's firearms business and competitive shooting success helped launch her security career.

amaru.ability: Use a grappling hook to reach windows, ledges, and open hatches quickly.
amaru.biography: Quispe began as an anthropologist protecting Peru's cultural heritage, later combining police experience with archaeological field work.

aruni.ability: Place laser gates across entryways to punish intruders.
aruni.biography: A former private detective, Aruni joined Thailand's police after uncovering a Bangkok bombing plot. Her investigations also targeted human trafficking.

ash.ability: Fire breaching rounds from a distance to break soft surfaces and open new angles.
ash.biography: Cohen studied structural engineering before serving in Israel's military. Her training combined technical expertise with demanding ground and airborne operations.

azami.ability: Throw kunai that expand into solid cover, sealing exposed angles.
azami.biography: Raised in Kyoto, Azami pursued martial arts and languages before entering Tokyo's police academy. Her discipline shaped a career in personal protection.

bandit.ability: Electrify defensive surfaces to interfere with enemy breaches.
bandit.biography: Brunsmeier followed his father into policing. Crisis response, aviation, and undercover work became central to his career.

blackbeard.ability: Carry an adaptable shield alongside a primary weapon and breach soft walls with its pneumatic system.
blackbeard.biography: Jenson chose naval service over his family's medical tradition. Early cadet experience helped set him on the path to the Navy SEALs.

blitz.ability: Combine ballistic protection with a shield-mounted flash to pressure close opponents.
blitz.biography: Kötz excelled in both languages and athletics. His academic background complements a career built around demanding close-quarters operations.

brava.ability: Send a hacking drone to take over enemy devices, or disable those it cannot control.
brava.biography: After losing a cousin to violent crime, Cardoso studied law. Frustration with prosecution led her to Brazil's federal police.

buck.ability: Switch between a rifle and its attached shotgun to open soft surfaces.
buck.biography: Côté served in Canada's reserves while studying criminology, then developed expertise in military policing, rescue, and special operations.

capitao.ability: Use crossbow bolts to deliver fire and control an area.
capitao.biography: Souza entered policing after his brother's murder. He survived captivity during a cartel operation, including the injury that cost him an eye.

castle.ability: Reinforce entryways with tactical barricades to shape the attackers' routes.
castle.biography: Campbell moved from criminal-justice studies into the LAPD and SWAT. Team protection and careful control of entry points defined his work.

caveira.ability: Quietly incapacitate opponents and interrogate them for information.
caveira.biography: Pereira became a police informant after an early arrest. Undercover assignments developed her surveillance and interrogation expertise.

clash.ability: Use an electrical shield to slow opponents; anchor it and operate the taser remotely.
clash.biography: Evans began as a protest organizer. A mentor's death led her to seek change from within London's police service.

deimos.ability: Track a chosen enemy with a flying probe while exposing your own position; fight with the Vendetta during tracking.
deimos.biography: Morris developed his field skills with Special Forces and the ATF. His record also includes advanced chemistry studies and an early connection to Rainbow.

denari.ability: Link deployed devices into laser traps that injure and slow enemies.
denari.biography: Winzenried grew up in a politically prominent household. Games of chance became an outlet and helped shape his talent for deception and analysis.

doc.ability: Use a medical pistol to support teammates with emergency treatment.
doc.biography: Kateb trained in medicine in Paris and volunteered on humanitarian missions. He chose military healthcare over private practice.

dokkaebi.ability: Upload malware that disrupts observation tools and turns targeted enemy phones into explosive hazards.
dokkaebi.biography: Nam's talent for computing brought academic recognition and an early intelligence assignment. Her hacking expertise grew alongside military service.

echo.ability: Pilot a camera drone that can disorient enemies with ultrasonic bursts.
echo.biography: Enatsu began building robots and drones as a child. Engineering studies led him into Japanese police research and counter-terrorism work.

ela.ability: Hide proximity-triggered concussion mines to disrupt approaching opponents.
ela.biography: Bosak grew up under demanding military training alongside her sister Zofia. She later explored fine art in Berlin before returning to security work.

fenrir.ability: Place remotely activated mines to disrupt enemies around protected areas.
fenrir.biography: Svensson's interest in biology shifted during military service toward the emotional effects of combat and tactical organization.

finka.ability: Trigger a team-wide boost that supports injured allies and can help them recover from a downed state.

flores.ability: Drive an explosive drone into position, then lock it down and detonate it against defensive equipment.
flores.biography: Lucero turned to burglary while supporting his ill mother. He became known for targeting powerful criminals and helping poorer communities.

frost.ability: Set concealed mechanical traps to catch opponents moving through an entryway.
frost.biography: Tsang joined Canada's air force at eighteen, excelled at military college, and later served in coastal search and rescue.

fuze.ability: Send explosive clusters through soft surfaces to clear defensive positions.

glaz.ability: Provide ranged covering fire using a specialized rifle sight.

goyo.ability: Use incendiary equipment to block an area with fire.
goyo.biography: Hernández lost his father and sister in a bombing. His mother and Amaru helped guide him toward a naval education and military service.

gridlock.ability: Spread clusters of spikes that slow and injure enemies crossing the covered ground.
gridlock.biography: Fairous developed leadership and engineering skills early. Work with engines and robotics led her into Australia's army reserves and military service.

grim.ability: Launch a swarm of tracking bots to reveal opponents who enter its area.
grim.biography: Keng Boon learned wilderness survival from his father before joining Singapore's naval special forces and training as a combat diver.

hibana.ability: Launch remotely detonated pellets to open reinforced surfaces and create sightlines.
hibana.biography: Imagawa developed precise control through archery and international counter-terrorism training. Her specialty is leading teams through dangerous entries.

iana.ability: Scout using a controllable holographic double that mimics movement but cannot attack.
iana.biography: Meijer pursued aerospace engineering before shifting toward systems engineering. She developed advanced contact lenses after her eyesight prevented a piloting career.

iq.ability: Locate electronics using a wrist-mounted detector.
iq.biography: Weiss grew up in an academically driven family and pursued electrical engineering at MIT. Her work focused on microelectronics and advanced technology.

jackal.ability: Scan footprints to identify and track enemy movement.
jackal.biography: Al-Hassar's unsettled childhood was followed by his brother's unsolved murder. Support from a police officer inspired his own policing career.

jager.ability: Protect a position by intercepting incoming projectiles.
jager.biography: Streicher grew up around aviation machinery through his mechanic uncle. His interest in complex systems eventually shaped his defensive technology.

kaid.ability: Throw electrical devices that protect nearby reinforced surfaces and other metal defenses.
kaid.biography: El Fassi grew up fascinated by the Fortress training facility in Morocco's Atlas Mountains and its renowned commanders.

kali.ability: Pair a powerful sniper rifle with explosive lances for removing defensive gadgets.
kali.biography: Shah's ambition to serve in combat met institutional barriers. She left military service and pursued her own private military enterprise.

kapkan.ability: Place explosive traps on door and window frames to punish careless entry.

lesion.ability: Scatter toxin-injecting mines to injure and slow approaching enemies.
lesion.biography: Liu worked in shipbreaking alongside his father. Exposure to industrial hazards and later mine-clearance work shaped his understanding of dangerous materials.

lion.ability: Use an aerial sensor to detect enemy movement during timed scans.
lion.biography: Flament enlisted after a difficult period in his youth. Military structure helped him develop expertise in chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.

maestro.ability: Watch an area through a remote turret and expose its laser to attack targets.
maestro.biography: Martello trained at Italy's military academy and served as a paratrooper before qualifying for specialist counter-terrorism operations.

maverick.ability: Cut precise openings through reinforced surfaces with a close-range blowtorch.
maverick.biography: Thorn grew up speaking multiple languages and later served as an intelligence officer in Kabul. His career combined local knowledge with unconventional operations.

melusi.ability: Deploy sound-based devices that slow enemies entering their reach.
melusi.biography: Ndlovu grew up near a South African wildlife reserve. Concern for threatened animals and the danger of poaching shaped her drive to protect others.

mira.ability: Install a one-way observation window and choose when to open it into a firing angle.
mira.biography: Álvarez learned mechanical skills in her father's repair shop. Engineering studies and police service gave her a route into developing protective equipment.

montagne.ability: Extend a ballistic shield to provide broad frontal protection.
montagne.biography: Touré developed his career in French policing, from a visible street presence to crowd control and counter-terrorism training with GIGN.

mozzie.ability: Launch small robots that hijack enemy drones for defensive reconnaissance.
mozzie.biography: Goose trained in Australia's defense forces and became skilled in reconnaissance using dirt bikes and all-terrain vehicles.

mute.ability: Deploy signal jammers to interfere with nearby enemy electronics.
mute.biography: Chandar entered Cambridge unusually young and studied electronics and computing. Security research and code-breaking brought him to GCHQ's attention.

nokk.ability: Use concealment technology to avoid enemy observation tools during an approach.
nokk.biography: Much of Nøkk's personal history remains classified. The published record describes Danish military education and extensive covert-operations training.

nomad.ability: Attach repulsion devices to surfaces to knock back enemies who approach.
nomad.biography: El Maktoub's early travels encouraged a love of remote places. She later trained at Morocco's Fortress and served in mountain operations.

noor.ability: Fire piercing projectiles that ignite after passing through shields or destructible surfaces.
noor.biography: Murad grew up on military bases while his father served with Rainbow. After trying academic life, he joined Egypt's military and later earned his own place in Rainbow.

oryx.ability: Dash through soft walls and reach open hatches to change floors quickly.
oryx.biography: Al Hadid vanished from public records for many years. His later travels included training in wrestling, striking, driving, and marksmanship.

osa.ability: Carry or place transparent ballistic cover to hold an attacking angle.
osa.biography: Janković grew up in a family of toy makers and merchants. Settling with her aunt in Croatia gave her space to develop technical interests and a passion for science fiction.

pulse.ability: Track nearby heartbeats through surfaces to gather defensive intelligence.
pulse.biography: Estrada grew up on military bases and showed an early aptitude for science. Forensics and biochemistry led him into the FBI's biometrics program.

ram.ability: Send a motorized breacher along a route to destroy soft surfaces and equipment.
ram.biography: Choi grew up in orphanages in South Korea. Her early caregivers described someone observant and resourceful, with lasting interests in music and drawing.

rauora.ability: Deploy remotely placed door panels and use their triggers to control passage.
rauora.biography: Iwini followed her parents into public service, becoming a military captain before qualifying for New Zealand's SAS. Māori community and tradition remain central to her life.

rook.ability: Supply armor plates that improve the team's protection.
rook.biography: Nizan combined academic ability with a love of sports. After cycling across France, he entered the Gendarmerie and developed his policing skills.

sens.ability: Roll out projectors that create a visual screen across several angles.
sens.biography: Ngoma grew up exploring psychology, physics, music, and practical mechanics. That varied education became the foundation for their later work.

sentry.ability: Choose from the defensive secondary-gadget pool to adapt your equipment to the team.
sentry.biography: Sentries are Rainbow's defense recruits. Their training emphasizes adaptability and gives future specialists a place to build experience.

skopos.ability: Switch between two robotic shells, leaving the inactive unit as a protected observation point.
skopos.biography: Galanos fled unrest in Cyprus as a child. Police and military experience led to a long Rainbow career and later a shift toward remote operations.

sledge.ability: Break soft surfaces with a hammer to create entrances and vertical angles.
sledge.biography: Cowden grew up in Scotland and captained a youth rugby team. He followed his family's military tradition into armored engineering and infantry service.

smoke.ability: Position remotely triggered gas devices to deny routes and delay a push.
smoke.biography: Porter's unconventional education encouraged his talent for chemistry and biology. He later entered the British Army in search of practical challenges.

solid-snake.ability: Scan for nearby threats with a handheld radar and recover gadgets from fallen operators.
solid-snake.biography: Solid Snake's record is heavily classified. Ubisoft's dossier describes a veteran whose history is partly corroborated through Samuel Fisher.

solis.ability: Detect and mark enemy electronics using a wearable sensor.
solis.biography: Díaz joined Colombia's police out of a desire to protect others. Computing and investigative skills helped her uncover corruption and enter special operations.

striker.ability: Build a flexible attacking kit using the full attacker secondary-gadget pool.
striker.biography: Strikers are Rainbow's attack recruits. They support operations while developing the experience needed for future specialist roles.

tachanka.ability: Bounce incendiary grenades into difficult angles to deny enemy movement.

thatcher.ability: Detect electronics through cover and disable them with a targeted EMP device.
thatcher.biography: Baker chose military service over his family's dockworking trade. Observation, decisive action, and close-quarters expertise became hallmarks of his career.

thermite.ability: Coordinate with the team to open reinforced defenses using breaching charges.
thermite.biography: Trace served in the Marines and trained in explosive-ordnance disposal. A chemistry degree later supported his work with FBI hazardous-material and SWAT teams.

thorn.ability: Stick proximity-triggered explosive devices to surfaces to threaten nearby enemies.
thorn.biography: Thorn grew up around horses and a large family on an Irish farm. She chose a career with Ireland's police service.

thunderbird.ability: Place automated medical stations that help nearby injured or downed operators.
thunderbird.biography: Thunderbird grew up in Saskatchewan's Nakoda territories, learning community values and helicopter mechanics from her parents before military training.

tubarao.ability: Throw freezing devices to slow enemies, pause equipment, and reveal movement across affected surfaces.
tubarao.biography: Nunes grew up in the Azores, where natural disasters taught him the value of mutual aid. Time at sea with his father encouraged his maritime interests.

twitch.ability: Pilot a shock drone to gather information and remotely disable equipment.
twitch.biography: Pichon grew up in an academic family and joined army cadets at sixteen. Programming and robotics skills led her toward engineering for field operations.

valkyrie.ability: Place small cameras to give the team additional live viewing angles.
valkyrie.biography: Castellano was a promising swimmer before an injury ended that path. She shifted toward the Navy and university study.

vigil.ability: Conceal your image from nearby camera systems using electronic countermeasures.
vigil.biography: Hwa endured family loss before being adopted in South Korea. An interest in electronics later helped guide him into naval service.

wamai.ability: Use magnetic devices to pull incoming projectiles away from their intended destination.
wamai.biography: Furaha grew up in a Kenyan fishing community and showed remarkable diving ability. Naval service gave him a way to put those skills to use.

warden.ability: Activate specialized glasses to resist flashes and improve vision through smoke.
warden.biography: McKinley moved from the Marines to the Secret Service. His response to an attack on a diplomatic visit helped earn him a presidential protection assignment.

ying.ability: Deploy clusters of flash charges to disrupt defenders before an entry.
ying.biography: Siu began in close protection after school. Training abroad expanded her combat skills before she joined Hong Kong's police and Special Duties Unit.

zero.ability: Fire cameras into surfaces to observe both sides and use their laser against equipment.
zero.biography: Fisher attended military school and the US Naval Academy before SEAL training. Much of his later intelligence career remains classified.

zofia.ability: Switch between impact and concussion rounds in a dual-purpose launcher.
zofia.biography: Bosak grew up under rigorous training from her father, a former GROM commander. She later excelled in special-forces selection and survival skills.
